---
title: "Esprit de Corps — Monitor"
format:
  dashboard:
    theme: [darkly, custom.scss]
    orientation: rows
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    # Paint the graphics device the dashboard background colour, so composed
    # (patchwork) plots don't render on a white canvas.
    dev.args:
      bg: "#0d1b2a"
    # Render oversized and scale down in CSS — keeps charts crisp when they
    # stretch to the full card width.
    dpi: 150
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false

library(googlesheets4)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(jsonlite)
library(knitr)
library(purrr)

# ── Config ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
SHEET_ID    <- "1zoCyTX7alZ0V5YzpVLN9Qd2iIWrX1KYJx07065n_NFc"
POWER_SHEET <- "Power Log"
PUMP_SHEET  <- "Bilge Pump Log"
LAT         <- 41.57
LON         <- -71.45
TZ          <- "America/New_York"
RAIN_THRESH <- 0.01
ACR_COMBINE    <- 13.0
ACR_DISCONNECT <- 12.75
CONVERGE_TOL   <- 0.15

# ── Palette ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
C <- list(
  bg = "#0d1b2a", panel = "#152238", grid = "#1e3a5a",
  text = "#e0e8f0", muted = "#90a4ae", blue = "#2196F3",
  rain = "#1976D2", cycle = "#ff7043", green = "#4caf50",
  dryday = "#263850", line = "#546e7a"
)

# ── Load pump data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
gs4_deauth()

pump_raw <- tryCatch({
  raw <- read_sheet(SHEET_ID, sheet = PUMP_SHEET)
  names(raw) <- c("date", "start_t", "end_t", "duration")
  raw |>
    mutate(
      date     = as.Date(format(date, "%Y-%m-%d")),
      start_t  = format(start_t, "%H:%M:%S"),
      end_t    = format(end_t,   "%H:%M:%S"),
      duration = as.numeric(duration)
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(date))
}, error = function(e) {
  tibble(date = as.Date(character()), start_t = character(),
         end_t = character(), duration = numeric())
})

# ── Load power data ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
power_raw <- tryCatch({
  raw <- read_sheet(SHEET_ID, sheet = POWER_SHEET)
  names(raw) <- c("timestamp", "voltage", "current", "soc",
                  "consumed_ah", "time_to_go", "starter_v")
  raw |>
    mutate(
      timestamp   = suppressWarnings(as_datetime(as.character(timestamp), tz = TZ)),
      voltage     = as.numeric(voltage),
      current     = as.numeric(current),
      soc         = as.numeric(soc),
      consumed_ah = as.numeric(consumed_ah),
      time_to_go  = as.numeric(time_to_go),
      starter_v   = as.numeric(starter_v)
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(timestamp)) |>
    arrange(timestamp)
}, error = function(e) {
  tibble(timestamp = as.POSIXct(character()), voltage = numeric(),
         current = numeric(), soc = numeric(), consumed_ah = numeric(),
         time_to_go = numeric(), starter_v = numeric())
})

# ── Load rainfall ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
weather <- tryCatch({
  if (nrow(pump_raw) > 0) {
    url <- paste0(
      "https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast",
      "?latitude=", LAT, "&longitude=", LON,
      "&daily=precipitation_sum&precipitation_unit=inch",
      "&past_days=92&forecast_days=0&timezone=", URLencode(TZ)
    )
    r <- fromJSON(url)
    tibble(date = as.Date(r$daily$time),
           rainfall_in = replace_na(r$daily$precipitation_sum, 0))
  } else NULL
}, error = function(e) NULL)

# ── Daily pump summary + rain join ────────────────────────────────────────────
daily <- NULL
if (nrow(pump_raw) > 0) {
  date_seq <- seq(min(pump_raw$date), Sys.Date(), by = "day")
  daily <- pump_raw |>
    group_by(date) |>
    summarise(cycles = n(),
              avg_dur_s = mean(duration, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    right_join(tibble(date = date_seq), by = "date") |>
    mutate(cycles = replace_na(cycles, 0L)) |>
    arrange(date)
  if (!is.null(weather)) {
    daily <- daily |>
      left_join(weather, by = "date") |>
      mutate(rainfall_in = replace_na(rainfall_in, 0),
             is_rain_day = rainfall_in >= RAIN_THRESH)
  }
}

# ── Theme ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = C$bg, color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = C$panel, color = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = C$grid, linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    text = element_text(color = C$text),
    axis.text = element_text(color = C$muted),
    axis.title = element_text(color = C$muted),
    plot.title = element_text(color = C$text, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = C$muted, size = rel(0.85)),
    legend.text = element_text(color = C$muted),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

# ── Helper: latest power row ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
latest_power <- if (nrow(power_raw) > 0) slice_tail(power_raw, n = 1) else NULL

# ── Helper: value-box formatting ──────────────────────────────────────────────
fmt <- function(x, suffix = "", digits = 0, na = "\u2014") {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || is.na(x)) return(na)
  paste0(formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = ","), suffix)
}

# ── Leakage rate + sparkline data (rolling regression per rain event) ─────────
leak_rate    <- NA_real_
leak_spark   <- NULL
if (!is.null(daily) && "is_rain_day" %in% names(daily)) {
  rd <- daily |> filter(is_rain_day %in% TRUE) |> arrange(date)
  if (nrow(rd) >= 2) {
    leak_rate <- coef(lm(cycles ~ rainfall_in, data = rd))[2]
    # Sparkline: cumulative leakage-rate estimate as each rain event is added
    leak_spark <- purrr::map_dbl(2:nrow(rd), function(i) {
      coef(lm(cycles ~ rainfall_in, data = rd[1:i, ]))[2]
    })
  }
}
```

## Row {height=66%}

### Column {width=40%}

::: {.card title="Leakage Rate Trend"}

```{r}
#| fig-height: 3.8
#| fig-width: 5.5

if (!is.na(leak_rate) && !is.null(leak_spark) && length(leak_spark) >= 2) {
  spark_df <- tibble(x = seq_along(leak_spark), y = leak_spark)
  trend_up <- tail(leak_spark, 1) >= leak_spark[1]
  arrow_sym <- if (trend_up) "\u2191" else "\u2193"

  ggplot(spark_df, aes(x, y)) +
    geom_area(fill = C$green, alpha = 0.22) +
    geom_line(color = C$green, linewidth = 0.9) +
    annotate("text",
             x = mean(range(spark_df$x)),
             y = max(spark_df$y) * 1.02,
             label = paste0(round(leak_rate, 1), " cyc/in ", arrow_sym),
             color = C$green, size = 7, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.25))) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = C$bg, color = NA),
          plot.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6))
} else {
  ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
             label = "Need \u2265 2 rain events",
             color = C$muted, size = 5) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = C$bg, color = NA))
}
```

Cycles per inch of rain. Rising trend indicates worsening bow ingress.

### Column {width=60%}

::: {.card title="Recent Bilge Activity"}

```{r}
if (nrow(pump_raw) > 0) {
  pump_raw |>
    arrange(desc(date), desc(start_t)) |>
    slice_head(n = 14) |>
    mutate(Duration = paste0(duration, "s")) |>
    transmute(Date = format(date, "%b %d"),
              Start = substr(start_t, 1, 8),
              End = substr(end_t, 1, 8),
              Duration) |>
    kable()
} else {
  cat("No bilge events recorded yet.")
}
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
# Render timestamp lives in the navbar (top right) so it is visible on every
# page. Emits only a <script>; nothing is drawn in this card.
# ASCII only — a literal "·" here renders as "<U+00B7>" under a non-UTF-8 locale.
.stamp <- format(with_tz(Sys.time(), TZ), "%b %d, %Y %H:%M %Z")
cat(sprintf(
'<script>
(function () {
  var s = "Updated %s";
  function place() {
    var n = document.querySelector(".navbar .navbar-container");
    if (!n || n.querySelector(".navbar-updated")) return;
    var e = document.createElement("span");
    e.className = "navbar-updated";
    e.textContent = s;
    n.appendChild(e);
  }
  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", place);
  } else { place(); }
})();
</script>', .stamp))
```

# Bilge Pump

## Row

::: {.card title="Rainfall + Bilge Pump Cycles"}

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4.0
#| fig-width: 16

if (!is.null(daily) && nrow(daily) > 0 && "rainfall_in" %in% names(daily)) {
  n <- nrow(daily)
  brk <- if (n <= 14) "1 day" else if (n <= 60) "1 week" else "1 month"

  p_rain <- ggplot(daily, aes(date)) +
    geom_col(aes(y = rainfall_in,
                 fill = if_else(is_rain_day, "Rain", "Dry")),
             width = 0.7, alpha = 0.9) +
    # Dry days are 0-height bars, so the legend swatch carried no information
    # and cost vertical space — the subtitle already explains the colours.
    scale_fill_manual(name = NULL,
                      values = c("Rain" = C$rain, "Dry" = C$dryday),
                      guide = "none") +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %d", date_breaks = brk) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
    labs(subtitle = "Blue = rain \u2022 Orange = pump cycles \u2022 \u2715 = dry day / no cycles",
         y = "Rain (in)", x = NULL) +
    plot_theme +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")

  p_cyc <- ggplot(daily, aes(date)) +
    geom_col(data = filter(daily, cycles > 0), aes(y = cycles),
             fill = C$cycle, width = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = filter(daily, cycles == 0), aes(y = 0),
               shape = 3, color = C$muted, size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %d", date_breaks = brk) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    labs(y = "Cycles", x = NULL) +
    plot_theme

  # plot_annotation() is what paints the *composition* background — without it
  # patchwork draws the assembled plot on white regardless of the device bg.
  p_rain / p_cyc +
    plot_layout(heights = c(2, 3)) +
    plot_annotation(theme = theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = C$bg, color = NA),
      plot.margin     = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)))
} else {
  ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
    label = "No bilge data yet", color = C$muted, size = 6) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = C$bg, color = NA))
}
```

:::

## Row

::: {.card title="Cycles vs. Rainfall"}

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4.0
#| fig-width: 16

if (!is.null(daily) && "is_rain_day" %in% names(daily)) {
  rd <- daily |> filter(is_rain_day %in% TRUE)
  if (nrow(rd) >= 2) {
    fit <- lm(cycles ~ rainfall_in, data = rd)
    ggplot(rd, aes(rainfall_in, cycles)) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = C$green, fill = C$green,
                  alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 0.8) +
      geom_point(aes(color = as.numeric(date)), size = 4, alpha = 0.9) +
      scale_color_gradient(low = C$line, high = C$cycle,
        name = "Date", n.breaks = 4,
        labels = \(x) format(as.Date(x, origin = "1970-01-01"), "%b %d"),
        guide = guide_colorbar(barheight = 8, barwidth = 0.5)) +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf,
        label = paste0("Slope: ", round(coef(fit)[2], 1),
                       " cyc/in\nR\u00b2 = ", round(summary(fit)$r.squared, 2)),
        color = C$green, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.3, size = 4) +
      labs(subtitle = "Rain days only \u2022 steepening slope \u2192 worsening ingress",
           x = "Rainfall (inches)", y = "Pump cycles") +
      plot_theme +
      theme(legend.position = "right")
  } else {
    ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
      label = paste0("Need \u2265 2 rain events (", nrow(rd), " so far)"),
      color = C$muted, size = 6) +
      theme_void() +
      theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = C$bg, color = NA))
  }
}
```

# Power

## Row

::: {.card title="Battery Voltage — with ACR state"}

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4.2
#| fig-width: 16

if (nrow(power_raw) > 0) {
  cutoff <- Sys.time() - 7 * 86400
  d <- power_raw |> filter(timestamp >= cutoff)

  # Infer combined state
  d_state <- d |>
    filter(!is.na(voltage), !is.na(starter_v)) |>
    mutate(combined = abs(voltage - starter_v) <= CONVERGE_TOL &
             voltage > ACR_DISCONNECT & starter_v > ACR_DISCONNECT)

  shade <- NULL
  if (any(d_state$combined)) {
    r <- rle(d_state$combined)
    ends <- cumsum(r$lengths); starts <- ends - r$lengths + 1
    idx <- which(r$values)
    shade <- tibble(xmin = d_state$timestamp[starts[idx]],
                    xmax = d_state$timestamp[ends[idx]])
  }

  d_long <- d |>
    select(timestamp, House = voltage, Starter = starter_v) |>
    pivot_longer(-timestamp, names_to = "bank", values_to = "v") |>
    filter(!is.na(v))

  p <- ggplot()
  if (!is.null(shade) && nrow(shade) > 0) {
    p <- p + geom_rect(data = shade,
      aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
      fill = C$green, alpha = 0.10, inherit.aes = FALSE)
  }
  p +
    geom_hline(yintercept = ACR_COMBINE, color = C$green,
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = ACR_DISCONNECT, color = C$cycle,
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    annotate("text", x = min(d_long$timestamp), y = ACR_COMBINE,
             label = paste0("ACR combine (", ACR_COMBINE, "V)"),
             color = C$green, size = 3, hjust = 0, vjust = -0.4) +
    annotate("text", x = min(d_long$timestamp), y = ACR_DISCONNECT,
             label = paste0("ACR disconnect (", ACR_DISCONNECT, "V)"),
             color = C$cycle, size = 3, hjust = 0, vjust = 1.3) +
    geom_line(data = d_long, aes(timestamp, v, color = bank), linewidth = 0.7) +
    scale_color_manual(name = NULL,
                       values = c("House" = C$blue, "Starter" = C$cycle)) +
    scale_x_datetime(date_labels = "%b %d", date_breaks = "1 day") +
    labs(subtitle = "House vs. starter \u2022 shaded = ACR combined (inferred)",
         x = NULL, y = "Volts") +
    plot_theme
} else {
  ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
    label = "No power data yet", color = C$muted, size = 6) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = C$bg, color = NA))
}
```

```{r}
if (nrow(power_raw) > 0) {

  if (nrow(d) > 0) {

      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "SOC (%)") +
      plot_theme
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 3.6

if (nrow(power_raw) > 0) {
  d <- power_raw |> filter(timestamp >= Sys.time() - 24*3600, !is.na(current))
  if (nrow(d) > 0) {
    ggplot(d, aes(timestamp, current)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = C$muted, linewidth = 0.5) +

      scale_x_datetime(date_labels = "%H:%M", date_breaks = "3 hours") +
      labs(subtitle = "Positive = charging", x = NULL, y = "Amps") +
      plot_theme
  }
}
```
